amendment: A1 equivalence instrument (CPU Stage A only)
frozen_text: A1 required the new loop soup to be bitwise identical to bp.train_supervised.

evidence.local_workstation: bp twice and tat twice all produced identical soup hashes (max abs diff 0.0)
evidence.remote_res_cpu: two bp runs differ at the last bits

changed_to: A1 passes when the batch-order hash and init hash are identical, the LR values at every epoch are exactly equal, the train-MAE curve is within max(1e-9, 2 * bp-repeat curve diff), and max|soup_new - soup_bp| <= max(1e-6, 2 * max|soup_bp_repeat - soup_bp|), i.e. the new loop is within this machine's own measured run-to-run noise floor.
why: the remote CPU is run-to-run non-deterministic at ~3e-7 in float32 parameters for the same frozen loop, so bitwise equality cannot witness code equivalence there; the local bitwise identity and the noise-floor comparison together establish loop equivalence
not_changed: no model, recipe, auxiliary schedule/lambda, seed, gate threshold, label-access rule, budget or decision vocabulary changed; made after CPU Stage-A probes and before any GPU trajectory; no Monitor or Locked label read
